fact: The ODPP, NC4 and National Police Service guide sets out how offences under the Computer Misuse and Cybercrimes Act, Cap 79C, are investigated and prosecuted, treating the Act as in force.
title: A Rapid Reference Guide: Investigation and Prosecution of Offences under the Computer Misuse and Cybercrimes Act, Cap 79C
publisher: Office of the Director of Public Prosecutions
